vocabulary.definition: an indefinitely long period of time; an age
vocabulary.example: An estimated four billion species emerged on our planet in past eons.

vocabulary.definition: to convert into a fossil; to become hardened or inflexible
vocabulary.example: For a dead animal to fossilize, a number of things must go just right.

vocabulary.definition: to form into crystals or assume a crystalline form
vocabulary.example: What remains the longest are the crystalized parts of your bones.

vocabulary.definition: the role and position a species has in its environment; how it meets its needs for food and shelter
vocabulary.example: Animals so weird and selected for ecological niches so specific that evolution molded their bodies very absurdly.

vocabulary.definition: people who protect or defend something
vocabulary.example: We could become the guardians of life and preserve it where we find it.

vocabulary.definition: increasing in rate, amount, or extent
vocabulary.example: Instead of accelerating the extinction we are witnessing, we could become the guardians of life.
